title: SimpleDayCounter
description: Simple DayCounter. This mod add Day count in HUD
body:
This mod adds a day counter to your Minecraft HUD.

## What it does:


```
Displays the current in-game day number on your screen (top left corner by default)

Updates automatically when a new day begins

Uses the same day calculation as F3 debug screen (1 day = 20 minutes / 24000 ticks)
```


## Features:


```
Adapting to the client's language

Lightweight, no performance impact

Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

Clean and readable display

Shows days without opening F3 menu
```


Note: _Client-side mod only. Does not require server installation._
